components.notes: Use exact ESP32-C3FH4X package pinout during schematic generation. Avoid GPIOs reserved for embedded flash (pins 4,5,18-24) and strapping functions (GPIO2/8/9). USB uses GPIO18/GPIO19. Host-facing controller only — no direct target-facing signals.

Target-facing SWD/UART/VTREF/nRESET timing coprocessor managed by ESP32-C3FH4X. Internal management by ESP32-C3 via SWD (pins 24/25), RUN (pin 26), BOOTSEL control. Communicates over SPI for command/response/stream channels. No direct USB connection to host. See pin_map for physical-pin-to-GPIO mapping.

components._note: LED_TGT lights when +5V_SW_TGT is enabled (JP_TGT_PWR jumper fitted, NexDAP outputs 5V to target). Connected between +5V_SW_TGT and GND through 330R current-limiting resistor. Does not indicate VTREF presence — target may be self-powered with jumper removed.

nets.name: +5V_TGT_FUSED
nets._note: Fused +5V before target power enable jumper. JP_TGT_PWR jumper bridges this to +5V_SW_TGT.

nets.name: +5V_SW_TGT
nets._note: Switchable +5V output to target connector pin 9 and target power LED. Enabled only when JP_TGT_PWR jumper is installed. LED_TGT lights whenever +5V is present on this net.

nets.name: ESP_RP_BOOTSEL_CTRL
nets._note: ESP32-C3 GPIO20 drives Q_RP_BOOTSEL gate through 100R. LOW/Hi-Z during normal operation. HIGH only when forcing RP2040 BOOTSEL mode. 100k gate pulldown guarantees inactive state during ESP32-C3 reset.

nets.name: USB_DP
nets._note: USB D+ connected to ESP32-C3 GPIO19 (native USB).

nets.name: USB_DM
nets._note: USB D- connected to ESP32-C3 GPIO18 (native USB).

nets.name: RP_TO_ESP_IRQ
nets._note: RP2040-to-ESP32 interrupt line (ESP32 GPIO21). Must support input interrupt. ESP32 is SPI master and can initiate transfers, so only one IRQ line is needed.

nets.name: ESP_RP_SWCLK
nets._note: ESP32-C3 internal SWD management interface to RP2040 SWCLK (RP2040 pin 24 = dedicated SWCLK). Used for first-time programming, firmware recovery, and diagnostics. Not connected to target SWD.

nets.name: ESP_RP_SWDIO
nets._note: ESP32-C3 internal SWD management interface to RP2040 SWDIO (RP2040 pin 25 = dedicated SWDIO). Uses ESP32 GPIO2 (strapping pin, 10k pull-up). Verify RP2040 SWDIO does not disturb ESP32 GPIO2 boot level during reset.

nets.name: RP_TGT_SWCLK
nets._note: RP2040 target-facing SWCLK through 22R protection resistor. See pin_map for exact GPIO. Separate from ESP32-C3 internal management SWCLK (RP2040 pin 24).

nets.name: RP_TGT_SWDIO
nets._note: RP2040 target-facing bidirectional SWDIO through 22R protection resistor. See pin_map for exact GPIO. Separate from ESP32-C3 internal management SWDIO (RP2040 pin 25).

nets.name: TGT_SWO_IN
nets._note: Target SWO trace input to RP2040 through 22R protection resistor. See pin_map for exact GPIO.

nets.name: RP_TGT_UART_TX
nets._note: RP2040 target UART TX through 22R series resistor. See pin_map for exact GPIO. RP2040 forwards target UART data to ESP32-C3 over SPI stream channel.

nets.name: TGT_UART_TX
nets._note: Target connector UART TX (J_TGT pin 7). Protected by 22R series resistor. No ESD diode in V2 — add ESD protection in product revision if connector exposed to frequent hot-plugging.

nets.name: TGT_UART_RX
nets._note: Target connector UART RX (J_TGT pin 8). Protected by 22R series resistor. No ESD diode in V2.

nets.name: RP_TGT_UART_RX
nets._note: RP2040 target UART RX through 22R series resistor. See pin_map for exact GPIO. Target UART data forwarded to ESP32-C3 over SPI stream channel.

nets.name: VTREF_TARGET
nets._note: Raw target reference voltage from J_TGT pin 1. It powers only target-side references such as nRESET pull-up, ESD clamp rail, and the VTREF ADC divider; it must not feed the local 3.3V rail.

nets.name: VTREF_ADC
nets._note: Divided target reference voltage measured by RP2040 GPIO26_ADC0 (pin 38) and reported to ESP32-C3 through SPI.

pin_map._note: Physical-pin to function/GPIO mapping. Authoritative reference for schematic generation. U_ESP32 = ESP32-C3FH4X QFN32 (5x5 mm). U_RP2040 = RP2040 QFN-56 (7x7 mm). Pin 57 on RP2040 = exposed thermal pad (GND).

_verification_required: RP2040 physical pin mapping has been aligned to the imported RP2040 symbol: TESTEN=19, GPIO26_ADC0=38, ADC_AVDD=43.
ESP32-C3 pin map is based on ESP32-C3FH4X QFN32; verify strapping pin requirements before schematic sign-off.
ESP32 GPIO2 (ESP_RP_SWDIO): confirm 10k pull-up to +3V3 satisfies strapping requirement, and RP2040 SWDIO state during reset does not pull GPIO2 below VIH.
ESP32 GPIO20 (BOOTSEL_CTRL) and GPIO21 (RP_TO_ESP_IRQ): confirm these are usable regular GPIOs in the selected ESP32-C3FH4X configuration.
RP2040 QSPI pin assignments (pins 51-56): verify each QSPI function against the flash footprint and RP2040 datasheet.
VTREF_TARGET is the raw target-side reference on J_TGT pin 1; only VTREF_ADC is connected to RP2040 ADC pin 38.
Before PCB layout, generate a complete physical-pin-to-net cross-reference from this pin_map and validate against schematic netlist.

design_decisions: ESP32-C3FH4X is the only host-facing controller providing USB, Wi-Fi, BLE, TCP, configuration and management services.
RP2040 does not expose USB directly to the host. RP2040 USB pins (DM/DP) are left unconnected.
USB-C D+/D- are connected to ESP32-C3 native USB pins GPIO19/GPIO18 instead of RP2040.
RP2040 acts as a deterministic target-facing SWD and UART timing coprocessor managed by ESP32-C3.
SPI is the primary command/response/stream channel between ESP32-C3 and RP2040 during normal operation.
Only one RP2040-to-ESP32 interrupt line is required. ESP32-C3 is the SPI master and can initiate transfers without ESP_TO_RP_IRQ.
ESP32-C3 provides an internal SWD maintenance interface to RP2040 using SWDIO (ESP GPIO2, RP pin 25), SWCLK (ESP GPIO5, RP pin 24) and RUN (ESP GPIO3, RP pin 26).
The internal ESP32-C3-to-RP2040 SWD interface is used for first-time RP2040 programming, firmware recovery and low-level diagnostics.
RP2040 target-facing SWD (TGT_SWDIO, TGT_SWCLK) uses separate GPIO pins from the internal management SWD pins (24, 25). Verify exact GPIO mapping against RP2040 datasheet.
RP2040 BOOTSEL is actively controlled by ESP32-C3 GPIO20 through an NMOS open-drain pulldown circuit (Q_RP_BOOTSEL, 2N7002).
ESP_RP_BOOTSEL_CTRL = LOW/Hi-Z during normal operation, HIGH only when forcing RP2040 BOOTSEL mode. 100k gate pulldown guarantees inactive state during ESP32-C3 reset.
ESP_RP_BOOTSEL_CTRL must remain inactive during normal RP2040 execution to avoid interfering with the RP2040 external QSPI Flash chip-select line.

To enter RP2040 BOOTSEL: 1) Drive RUN low, 2) Assert ESP_RP_BOOTSEL_CTRL (HIGH) to pull QSPI_SS low via NMOS, 3) Release RUN, 4) Hold BOOTSEL asserted for ROM sampling, 5) Deassert BOOTSEL_CTRL after entry.
Normal RP2040 boot: 1) Keep ESP_RP_BOOTSEL_CTRL inactive, 2) Release RUN, 3) RP2040 boots from external QSPI Flash.
ESP32-C3 shall not directly share or drive the RP2040 external QSPI Flash bus.
RP2040 manual BOOTSEL and RESET buttons are removed. ESP32-C3 manages all RP2040 boot modes.
ESP32-C3 has its own BOOT (GPIO9) and RESET (CHIP_EN) buttons for host-side maintenance.
ESP_RP_SWDIO uses ESP32-C3 GPIO2 (strapping pin). Verify ESP32-C3FH4X GPIO2 strapping requirements — GPIO2 has 10k pull-up to +3V3 and RP2040 SWDIO must not disturb ESP32-C3 boot mode during reset.
ESP32-C3 GPIO20 (BOOTSEL_CTRL, pin 27) and GPIO21 (RP_TO_ESP_IRQ, pin 28) are regular GPIOs — no conflict with flash, USB, strapping, or JTAG. Confirm before schematic sign-off.
Target UART bridge is implemented by RP2040 instead of ESP32-C3 to save ESP32-C3 GPIOs and keep all target-facing realtime I/O on the RP2040 side.
RP2040 forwards target UART data to ESP32-C3 over the SPI command/stream channel.
ESP32-C3 exposes the UART bridge to host through USB CDC, TCP socket, WebSocket, or BLE service.
Target UART TX/RX have 22R series resistors only in V2. Add ESD protection (e.g. separate ESD array) in product revision if target UART connector is exposed to frequent hot-plugging.
VTREF is measured by RP2040 ADC and reported to ESP32-C3 through SPI. Verify RP2040 VTREF pin supports ADC input.
ESP32-C3 does not directly sample target voltage in V1.
VTREF shall not share the ESP32-C3-to-RP2040 SWDIO line.

LED_TGT lights when +5V_SW_TGT is enabled (JP_TGT_PWR jumper fitted, NexDAP outputs 5V to target). Does not indicate VTREF presence — a self-powered target with jumper removed will have VTREF but LED_TGT off.
LED indicators: PWR=Green (3.3V rail present), DAP=Blue (RP2040 activity), TGT=Red (+5V_SW_TGT enabled).
Target 5V output is enabled through JP_TGT_PWR. Removing the jumper disconnects NexDAP 5V from the target connector to avoid conflict with self-powered target boards.
All target-facing protection retained: 22R series resistors on SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO/nRESET/UART, SRV05-4 ESD on SWD/SWO/nRESET, and 2N7002 open-drain nRESET.

Target connector (J_TGT, 2x4 2.54 mm header) fixed pinout — pin 1=+5V_SW_TGT, pin 2=TGT_SWDIO, pin 3=TGT_SWCLK, pin 4=TGT_SWO_OUT, pin 5=TGT_nRESET, pin 6=GND, pin 7=TGT_UART_TX, pin 8=TGT_UART_RX. Document on silkscreen.
200mA PTC fuse on target 5V output prevents short-circuit damage.
ESP32-C3 must not connect directly to any target connector signal (SWD, UART, nRESET, SWO, VTREF) in V2. All target-facing signals are handled exclusively by RP2040.

ESP32-C3 RF layout must follow Espressif hardware design guidelines: 50-ohm RF trace, matching network close to RF pin, chip antenna keepout region, ground via fence around RF path, no copper or traces under antenna keepout.
ANT1 (2450AT18A100E) keepout and land pattern must follow the antenna datasheet. The matching network (L_RF, C_RF_SHUNT) must be placed as close as practical to ESP32-C3 pin 1 (LNA_IN).
Before schematic sign-off: generate ESP32-C3FH4X and RP2040 physical-pin-to-net cross-reference from pin_map and verify against schematic netlist.
